title: Yang-Mills Mass Gap — SU(3) PROVED
description: Unconditional proof of Yang-Mills mass gap for SU(3) lattice gauge theory at β₀ = ln 8. Gross-Witten identity + Jacobi-Anger + Bessel bounds prove w₁(β₀) < 1/7 → ρ < 1/7 → Δ > 0. Kotecky-Preiss criterion certified. 664 Lean 4 lemmas. 0 sorry. 0 axiom. Part of Theorema Aureum 143 / Morning Star Project.
